name: Namrata Dhaba
signature_dish: Konkan fish thali with vade and bhakri
why_it_matters: Kolad town dhaba serving Konkan fish thali with rice-flour vade + jowar bhakri + sol kadi at reasonable prices — Outlook Traveller-recommended. The post-rafting lunch order for groups returning from the Kundalika 9am drop-off (the river is 12-15km from town).
insider_tip: Fish thali (₹250-300) + vade is the order; the Konkan thali here is closer to the Goan-Malvani style than the Maharashtrian dhaba norm. Open 7am-10pm. Cash + UPI.

name: Nature Trails Kundalika Resort Kitchen
why_it_matters: The flagship rafting camp on the Kundalika river (Village Kamat off Mulshi Road, Roha-Kolad) — homestyle Maharashtrian cuisine cooked with fresh local ingredients. Buffet style; open to non-resident rafting day-trippers who book the rafting + meal package. The natural lunch stop after the 9-11am rafting slot.
insider_tip: Most non-residents access this kitchen only via the rafting-camp package — book through Nature Trails / Thrillophilia. Standalone walk-ins are rare. Cash + UPI; cards via the central desk.
signature_address: Village Kamat, off Mulshi Road, Roha-Kolad, Raigad 402109

name: Prabhakar Lodge Restaurant
signature_dish: Non-veg thali with fish, rice, sol kadi and aamti
why_it_matters: Prabhakar Lodge serves Maharashtrian + Chinese + Punjabi + South Indian — the non-veg thali (fish + rice + sol kadi + aamti) is at ₹150, one of the cheapest Konkan fish thalis in Raigad. Outlook Traveller listed. Useful for budget rafters not staying at camps.
insider_tip: Non-veg thali at ₹150-200 is the standout-value order on the Mumbai-Kolad weekend rafting trail. Open 7am-10:30pm. Cash + UPI.
